# Astronomical 0.2.78
## What's new
- **Launch at login** — the menu-bar app can now start automatically when you log in, toggleable from the menu. - **Library destinations and offers** — downloaded models go to a destination you choose, the Library presents curated model offers, and every library entry is guaranteed to appear in the Library view. - **Chat lives in Thin Talk** — the menu bar opens the Thin Talk conversation window directly, and the Observatory's Chat view hands over through a one-click link with an always-visible menu-bar fallback, replacing the embedded Observatory chat playground. Existing sessions and state are preserved. - **Stability** — menu-bar shutdown now matches daemon processes through a shared matcher, ending stray-process leaks.
## Compatibility
- macOS 14.0 or later on Apple Silicon. - Existing sessions, user state, and model inventories are preserved. - The OpenAI-compatible API surface is unchanged.
## Distribution
This release is signed with a Developer ID Application certificate, notarized with Apple's notarization service, and stapled. Updates are delivered through a Sparkle feed signed with an Ed25519 key and verified before installation. SHA-256 digests for every published artifact are bound to the release manifest.
